caseName: New York Land Co. v. Republic of Philippines
caseNameFull: New York Land Co. v. Republic of the Philippines

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. Application of respondent for an extension of time within which to file a brief in opposition to the petition for writ of certiorari, presented to Justice Marshall, and by him referred to the Court, is granted and the time is extended to and including April 24, 1987.

Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
